monitor_reason: length: new pipe is 14.4 mi (23.2 km) Line KL, under the 15.5 mi (25 km) threshold; the other 5.8 mi is a 6 in liner inserted in existing FM120 (replacement, no new right-of-way), and the project adds no capacity. Not a match to P2537 (FM 100 Project, a different project) or any existing row.
researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 937: Line YM28 and Line FM120 Modernization Project, National Fuel Gas Supply Corp, Expansion, Completed, in service 2018-12-22, PA, 14.4 + 5.8 = 20.2 mi, 6 and 12 in, FERC CP17-74. A FERC order of March 15, 2018 authorized it (seen in search results, not opened). No existing GEM row covers it (P2537 FM 100 is different; P6878 is the whole main line). Operator page loaded but did not contain FM120 text, so not cited. A Federal Register notice of intent from May 2017 (FERC) loaded and states 14.4 mi of new Line KL, so two independent origins. Staged values shown for reference only; if a person rules that replacement pipe counts toward length (20.2 mi = 32.5 km), it would become a new row with 20.2 mi, status operating.
